MAP 模拟采用不设倒计时、逐题提交及本地题池自适应选题。新题池默认保存 65: The MAP simulation uses no countdown, topic-by-topic submission and adaptive topic selection from a local question pool. The new question pool saves 65 questions by default, and 43 questions are actually answered; the shorter import paper is marked as a special exercise. Reading covers literature, informational texts and vocabulary, and Language Usage covers writing revision, grammar and writing conventions. The question pool does not use official calibration parameters, and the report does not provide RIT scores. The interface refers to the NWEA public practice version, and the content is private learning materials.
保留现行 SAT / ACT 的完整英语部分，使用原创题目。SAT 两模块直接衔: Keep the full English section of the current SAT/ACT, using original questions. The two modules of the SAT are directly connected; the ACT English and Reading modules are directly connected. When choosing the Writing test, take a 5-minute rest before writing. This is an English-specific arrangement. The SAT refers to the Bluebook layout, and the ACT refers to the international CBT layout; regional and platform versions may differ. The scores show the accuracy of this paper, and no official score conversion is used. For the second module of SAT, the accuracy rate of this paper is 65% as the simulated diversion threshold.
首次准备整套题目需要数分钟至数十分钟，视模型速度与核验重试而定；可以暂停并续接。: Preparing the entire set of questions for the first time takes several minutes to dozens of minutes, depending on the speed of the model and verification retries; it can be paused and continued. After the official timer starts, closing the page will not suspend the exam.
